about: cap.so: scrolled the home page (a laptop mock-up with the Cap app and its own cursor in it, auto-rotating mode tabs), back to the top, Pricing in the nav bar, then the Lifetime switch on the Desktop License card. Recorded 2026-09-24 as 'Cap-demo'; production zoomed neither.
notes: The creator's pointer is a white Windows arrow, light:18; calibration gets it right.

Pricing: hand on the link from 20.4s, the new page arrives in ONE frame at ~21.1s. The tracker logged that frame as a quarter-screen 'shift' and the press was refused as 'the page was scrolling'. events.js scrolledAfter now needs two samples of shift before calling it a scroll.

Lifetime: hand on the switch from 26.6s, it flips at ~27.85s ($29 -> $58), the pointer leaves ~29.0s and the page scrolls at once. The change is a pastel pill and a line of text — 'nothing came of it' by the size test. locate.js stayedChanged compares the spot before the pointer arrived with after it left (35% changed).
The review stage's arbiter, run on this recording, called three auto-rotating tab changes presses and missed both real ones: keep STUDIO_AUTO_PRESS_ZOOMS=0.
stranger_budget_s / stranger_budget_pixel_s are RATCHETS measured on 2026-09-24. Lower them when they improve; never raise them.
